name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by his grandfather's stories of working on vintage race cars. He honed his skills through apprenticeships at local garages before securing a position with a regional racing team. His dedication to precision and problem-solving quickly made him an indispensable asset.

He joined RSC Motorsport three years ago, drawn by their commitment to innovation and their competitive spirit. Nikola is known for his meticulous approach to fabrication, ensuring every component meets the highest standards of quality. He's driven by a desire to push the boundaries of engineering and contribute to the team's success on the track. Nikola's demanding nature stems from his belief that only perfection can deliver victory.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Nikola is of average height, with a wiry build and calloused hands that speak to his hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any fabrication project.
Insists on listening to classical music while working, claiming it enhances his focus.
Has a collection of vintage tools he occasionally uses for specific tasks, believing in their superior craftsmanship.
